_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd squad/egg-squad.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds the squad tag, automatic ports instead of fixed defaults (game + 1, query, query + 1, beacon and RCON; upstream gave every server the beacon port 15000), Source RCON with a generated password written to Rcon.cfg (console commands go over it, the server reads none from its console), a broadcast command, install sandbox defaults and resource hints. The install script fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server, removes the workshop manifest from the right folder and only copies mods when some were downloaded. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". An Auto Update variable (default 1) keeps the update before every start that the upstream image did without one.
name: Squad
author: brycea@terrahost.cloud
description: Squad is a 50 vs 50 multiplayer first-person shooter that aims to capture combat realism through communication and teamplay. Major features include vehicle-based combined arms gameplay, large scale environments, base building, and integrated positional VoIP for proximity talking & radio.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'

##
#
# Variables
# STEAM_USER, STEAM_PASS, STEAM_AUTH - Steam user setup. If a user has 2fa enabled it will most likely fail due to timeout. Leave blank for anon install.
# WINDOWS_INSTALL - if it's a windows server you want to install set to 1
# SRCDS_APPID - steam app id found here - https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List
# SRCDS_BETAID - beta branch of a steam app. Leave blank to install normal branch
# SRCDS_BETAPASS - password for a beta branch should one be required during private or closed testing phases.. Leave blank for no password.
# INSTALL_FLAGS - Any additional SteamCMD  flags to pass during install.. Keep in mind that steamcmd auto update process in the docker image might overwrite or ignore these when it performs update on server boot.
# AUTO_UPDATE - Adding this variable to the egg allows disabling or enabling automated updates on boot. Boolean value. 0 to disable and 1 to enable.
#
 ##

# Install packages. Default packages below are not required if using our existing install image thus speeding up the install process.
#apt -y update
#apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

## Deleted app workshop file if available to not save mods ID`s for the future as that will interviene with the mods specified in the variables tab
rm -f /mnt/server/steamapps/workshop/appworkshop_393380.acf

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

# Install the game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} \
    $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) \
    +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) \
    $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate \
    $(IFS=','; for item in $WORKSHOP_ITEMS; do echo "+workshop_download_item 393380 ${item}"; done) \
    +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done
## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

if test -f "/mnt/server/steamapps/workshop/appworkshop_393380.acf"; then
    # Remove the Steam workshop file to prevent conflict with mods specified in the variables tab
    rm /mnt/server/steamapps/workshop/appworkshop_393380.acf
fi

## Moves downloaded mods to the necesary folder
if compgen -G "/mnt/server/steamapps/workshop/content/393380/*" > /dev/null; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/SquadGame/Plugins/Mods
    cp -rf /mnt/server/steamapps/workshop/content/393380/* /mnt/server/SquadGame/Plugins/Mods/
    rm -rf /mnt/server/steamapps/workshop/content/393380/*
fi
echo -e "Moving downloaded mods if available\n"

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/SquadGame/Binaries/Linux/SquadGameServer" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Squad dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## add below your custom commands if needed
chmod +x /mnt/server/SquadGame/Binaries/Linux/SquadGameServer

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: ld lib path
variables.description: this is needed for some reason

variables.name: Game ID
variables.description: The ID corresponding to the game to download and run using SRCDS.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name for the server in the server list

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Sets the maximum number of players.

variables.name: Allow Team Change
variables.description: Allow players to change teams ( true / false )

variables.name: Advertise Server
variables.description: Have the server report to the public server list ( true / false )

variables.name: Reserved Slots
variables.description: The number of reserved slots for admins / mods

variables.name: Prevent Team Change If Unbalanced
variables.description: This will prevent players from changing teams if they're already unbalanced ( true / false )

variables.name: Enforce Team Balance
variables.description: This will FORCE team balance if the teams are too uneven ( true / false )

variables.name: Record Demos
variables.description: This will record demos of the players ( true / false )

variables.name: Download Workshops Items
variables.description:
Workshop file ids separated by a comma "," (1111111,222222) 
Reinstall Required to install mods

variables.name: Game Port + 1
variables.description: Squad also uses the game port + 1 (UDP). Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port). The game picks this port itself and doesn't read this setting; Octail only reserves it.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port, passed as QueryPort=. Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: Query Port + 1
variables.description: Squad also uses the query port + 1. Set by Octail when the server is created (three after the game port). The game picks this port itself and doesn't read this setting; Octail only reserves it.

variables.name: Beacon Port
variables.description: Beacon port, passed as -beaconport=. Set by Octail when the server is created (four after the game port).

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: RCON port (TCP), written to SquadGame/ServerConfig/Rcon.cfg at every start. Set by Octail when the server is created (five after the game port).

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Generated by Octail when the server is created; written to Rcon.cfg. Octail sends console commands over RCON.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1), or start the installed files (0). Squad clients only join servers of their own version.
